title: SpongeBob Laugh
blurb: That nasal, dolphin-adjacent giggle either delights you or destroys you, and the deciding variable is repetition count. Tom Kenny has said the laugh was built to sound like a seagull, which explains a great deal, and it is now among the most recognisable noises ever animated. Use it sincerely to express joy, or loop it eleven times as a form of psychological warfare against a friend on a call — both are entirely canon. The laugh that raised one generation and quietly wore down the patience of the one before it, available here in a single button.
